  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Operations Manager",
  "description": "Ellasot Consulting - Our client, a reputable organization, is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Operations Manager
Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking for an experienced and strategic Operations Manager to oversee the organization&#39;s functions.
	The Operations Manager will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the organization, ensuring that all facilities, entertainment activities, games, and service departments operate efficiently.
	The role involves coordinating departmental activities, supervising staff, maintaining operational standards, ensuring customer satisfaction, and implementing procedures that improve productivity, safety, and overall business performance.


The Key Requirements
Daily Operations Management:


	Oversee the daily activities of the park to ensure smooth and efficient operations.
	Coordinate the activities of different departments, including games, arcade, cinema, food and beverage, customer service, and facility maintenance.
	Ensure all attractions, equipment, and facilities are functional and ready for daily operations.
	Develop and implement operational procedures to improve efficiency and service delivery.
	Monitor daily opening and closing activities and ensure operational readiness.


Staff Supervision and Management:


	Supervise supervisors, team leads, and operational staff across different departments.
	Prepare staff duty rosters and ensure adequate staffing for daily operations and special events.
	Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, discipline, and productivity.
	Identify training needs and ensure employees receive appropriate operational and customer service training.
	Promote teamwork, accountability, and professionalism among staff.


Customer Service and Experience:


	Ensure customers receive excellent service throughout their visit.
	Monitor customer feedback and address complaints or service-related issues promptly.
	Ensure proper handling of customer enquiries, bookings, and reservations.
	Work with relevant departments to improve customer satisfaction and repeat patronage.
	Ensure staff maintain a welcoming, friendly, and professional attitude towards customers.


Facility and Equipment Management:


	Monitor the condition and functionality of games, rides, entertainment equipment, and other facilities.
	Coordinate routine maintenance, repairs, and servicing of equipment.
	Ensure cleanliness, organisation, and proper maintenance of the entire facility.
	Report equipment faults and ensure prompt resolution to minimise operational downtime.
	Maintain proper records of maintenance activities and equipment performance.


Health, Safety and Security:


	Ensure compliance with health, safety, hygiene, and security procedures.
	Conduct regular operational and safety inspections.
	Ensure safety guidelines are followed when operating games, rides, and other entertainment facilities.
	Coordinate emergency response procedures and incident reporting.
	Work with security personnel to maintain a safe environment for customers and employees.


Inventory and Cost Control:


	Monitor the use and availability of operational supplies, equipment, and consumables.
	Ensure proper inventory management and minimise wastage.
	Monitor departmental expenses and recommend cost-saving measures.
	Ensure accurate records of operational materials, equipment, and maintenance expenses.
	Report shortages, damages, and unusual stock movements to management.


Events and Special Activities:


	Coordinate the operational requirements for birthdays, corporate events, school visits, and private bookings.
	Ensure adequate staff, equipment, and facilities are available for scheduled events.
	Work with the marketing and customer service teams to ensure successful event delivery.
	Monitor event execution and address operational challenges.


Reporting and Performance Monitoring:


	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
	Monitor departmental performance and ensure operational targets are achieved.
	Report operational challenges, incidents, and maintenance requirements to the General Manager.
	Recommend improvements to operational processes, customer experience, and service delivery.


Requirement


	Bachelor&#39;s degree or HND in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Operations Management, or a related field.
	Minimum of 3&ndash;5 years of experience in operations management, preferably in hospitality, entertainment, leisure, recreation, or facility management.
	Experience supervising multiple teams or departments.
	Good knowledge of facility management, customer service, inventory control, and operational procedures.
	Strong leadership, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
	Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and public holidays, where required.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and operational reporting tools.


Key Competencies:


	Operations planning and coordination.
	Staff supervision and team leadership.
	Customer service management.
	Facility and equipment maintenance coordination.
	Health, safety, and risk management.
	Inventory and cost control.
	Problem-solving and decision-making.
	Reporting and performance monitoring.


Salary
N350,000 - N375,000 monthly.&nbsp;

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send an updated CV to: frontdeskellasot@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Only candidates residing in Port Harcourt will be considered.",

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary

	We are seeking for an experienced and strategic Operations Manager to oversee the organization's functions.
	The Operations Manager will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the organization, ensuring that all facilities, entertainment activities, games, and service departments operate efficiently.
	The role involves coordinating departmental activities, supervising staff, maintaining operational standards, ensuring customer satisfaction, and implementing procedures that improve productivity, safety, and overall business performance.

	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
	Monitor departmental performance and ensure operational targets are achieved.
	Report operational challenges, incidents, and maintenance requirements to the General Manager.

Requirement


	Bachelor's degree or HND in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Operations Management, or a related field.
	Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in operations management, preferably in hospitality, entertainment, leisure, recreation, or facility management.

	Good knowledge of facility management, customer service, inventory control, and operational procedures.
	Strong leadership, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
	Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and public holidays, where required.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and operational reporting tools.


Key Competencies:


	Operations planning and coordination.
	Staff supervision and team leadership.
	Customer service management.
	Facility and equipment maintenance coordination.
	Health, safety, and risk management.
	Inventory and cost control.
	Problem-solving and decision-making.
	Reporting and performance monitoring.


Salary
N350,000 - N375,000 monthly. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send an updated CV to: frontdeskellasot@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Only candidates residing in Port Harcourt will be considered.

Fraud Analyst Job at Avetium Consult




        
    

        
        Avetium Consult is a Business Process Outsourcing and Technology solutions company incorporated in Nigeria. Avetium Consult is what happens when top experts from top multinationals from diverse fields, with similar values come together to deliver transformational solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Fraud Analyst
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Contract
Work Mode: 24/7 Shift Operations

Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Monitor real-time fraud alerts and suspicious transactions.
	Investigate suspicious accounts, wallets, cards and customer activities.
	Identify fraud patterns, anomalies and emerging threats.
	Review and analyse transaction records, customer profiles and relevant evidence.
	Escalate confirmed and suspected fraud incidents appropriately.
	Prepare daily monitoring and shift handover reports.
	Maintain accurate case records and investigation documentation.
	Support fraud prevention, detection and risk mitigation initiatives.
	Identify control gaps and recommend improvements.
	Analyse fraud trends and provide insights to improve monitoring effectiveness.
	Ensure alerts are reviewed and resolved within approved SLAs.
	Participate in 24/7 shift operations, including weekends and public holidays as scheduled.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Banking and Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Information Systems, Cyber Security, Statistics, Computer Science, Criminology, or a related discipline.
	1-3 years of experience in Fraud Monitoring, Fraud Investigation, Financial Crime, Compliance in a banking sector.
	Professional certifications in Fraud Management, Risk Management, Compliance, or Financial Crime will be an added advantage.
	Experience working in a transaction monitoring or fraud operations environment is preferred.
	Experience using fraud management systems, case management tools, and monitoring platforms will be an added advantage.
	Experience within Banking, Fintech, Mobile Money, Payment Services, or Telecommunications industries is desirable.


Salary
N193,000 per month.
